Failure causes:
Job 601239351 fails because test_calendarEventCalendarOptions.js contains two spaces on otherwise empty line 78. The defect remains in the current source. Git blame assigns it to Bug 2061199. The supplied assessment covers all 96 jobs: two patch-caused failures and 94 unrelated failures, with no unknown causes. The separate accessibility failure in job 601239519 remains unresolved.

Changes:
Removed only the two spaces from mail/components/calendar/test/unit/test_calendarEventCalendarOptions.js. Kept the blank separator, executable code, and assertions unchanged. The diff matches the collected EditorConfig and local-example evidence, with no departures. relatedRepairs and sourceUpdates are empty, and priorFixup is null, so no existing repair was reused. Removed all temporary validation files.

Validation:
Prettier 3.8.5, matching this checkout's package version, passes. An in-memory comparison confirms that the original file fails Prettier, the repaired file passes, and the repair exactly matches Prettier output. Direct ESLint using this checkout's configuration reports zero errors and zero warnings. node --check and git diff --check pass. The final diff contains one changed line in one source file. HEAD remains 120631be1a28113287187f4b5bfc554a1fbc885f. No Git state was changed.

Validation limits:
This fixup repairs only job 601239351. Job 601239519 still requires a separate repair owned by 1974e52c0a3c9466383dd9904f5551008cf375da, which introduced test_onlySaveButtonInvokesSave. Its synthetic click targets the non-interactive dialog body. No accessibility checks were disabled and no coverage was removed.
